description: A half-kilo ingot of palladium with the Citadel crest struck deep into one face and a serial struck into the other. The serial is the problem. Every fence in Coldwater will take it; every one of them will take a bite out of the price for the trouble of grinding that off.
name: Citadel palladium ingot

tags.description: A crested half-kilo palladium ingot. Serialised, which is somebody's problem.
